name: ClearBytes
evidence: sets n bytes to 0 (ResetDmaController clears its settings with it)

name: GetDmaChannel
evidence: returns the register block of one of the ten DMA channels from g_dmaChannels, or 0 past the tenth

name: ResetDmaController
evidence: clears the channels g_dmaChannelsToReset marks, masks and clears the controller's interrupts, sets its settings to zero and enables it when asked; returns whether it was enabled (InitDmaChannels calls it)

name: SetDmaSettings
evidence: writes the controller's release, FIFO, stall and drain settings and its ring and hold words, and keeps them in g_dmaSettings

name: StartDmaChain
evidence: waits for a channel to finish, then starts it in chain mode from a tag address (SubmitPacketBuffer calls it)

name: StartDmaChainToMemory
evidence: waits for a channel to finish, then starts it in chain mode towards memory (StartFromSprChain calls it)

name: WaitDmaChannel
evidence: waits until a channel's transfer ends, or tests it, with a timeout (RunRenderThread calls it)
